auditScope: Status of the 1.4.2 candidate source (23 October 2026, not yet published) against each bounty requirement, with the evidence for it. pass: met and evidenced; partial: met in part, or not yet shown on the hardware or channel the requirement names; fail: not met. release-audit.md and docs/testing-1.4.2.md have the detail.

requirements.obligation: Run on compatible Android or GrapheneOS hardware
requirements.note: The bounty asks for Android or compatible GrapheneOS hardware. Runs on a Redmi 13C (6 GB, Android 13) and an Infinix X6840 (4 GB, Android 16), and on a 12 GB Android 15 image with no Google apps, which is what GrapheneOS lacks; not tried on a GrapheneOS phone itself.

requirements.obligation: Stay within a maximum 12 GB RAM environment
requirements.note: Qwen3.5 2B peaks at 3.45 GB and the 4B at 6.83 GB while answering (12 GB emulator, airplane mode); Gemma 4 26B is offered only on phones reporting 10.5e9 bytes or more and, with its weights read from the file, leaves 9.4 GB free on the 12 GB emulator.

requirements.obligation: Use at most 50 GB total installed storage
requirements.note: With all three models, every collection and the voice installed, Android reports 47.58 GB of storage for the app; the budget check refuses installs past 50 GB.

requirements.obligation: Work completely offline after installation and asset provisioning
requirements.note: Every device check on 22-23 October ran in airplane mode with Wi-Fi and mobile data off on the Redmi, the Infinix and the emulator: emergencies, lookups, explanations, read aloud.

requirements.obligation: Make no API, remote inference, web search, or network requests during use
requirements.note: Network use is limited by code to user-started downloads and the catalogue refresh, and every research check ran with the radios off; no packet capture during a run has been made.

requirements.obligation: Require no Google Play Services for core offline behavior
requirements.note: No Play Services dependency in the code or the APK, and the 12 GB emulator image used for every Gemma check carries no Google apps at all (pm lists no com.google.android.gms).

requirements.obligation: Handle explanation, comparison, synthesis, and reasoning beyond recall
requirements.note: Explanation, comparison, synthesis and reasoning are handled; on 40 sealed questions of those kinds Gemma 4 26B (12 GB phones) gives a good answer to 27 (68%), the 4B to 8 (20%), the 2B to 2 (5%).

requirements.obligation: Respond at speeds usable for real phone lookups
requirements.note: Lookups, guides, places and calculations answer in seconds on every phone; model answers take about 4 to 8 minutes with the 4B on a 6 GB Redmi 13C and a median of 92 s with Gemma on a 12 GB emulator; Gemma has not been timed on a 12 GB phone.

requirements.obligation: Publish the submission in a public GitHub repository
requirements.note: Public repository.

requirements.obligation: Include all code, assets, dependencies, and reproduction instructions
requirements.note: Code, patches, pack tools and their pinned inputs.

requirements.obligation: Document models, datasets, indexes, and other resources
requirements.note: Models and every offered collection with size, checksum, source and licence.

requirements.obligation: Work on real Android hardware at submission time
requirements.note: The candidate source is installed and checked on the Redmi 13C and the Infinix X6840 with the local test key; the public-key 1.4.2 APK is not yet built or installed anywhere.

requirements.obligation: Install and run within minutes without substantial debugging
requirements.note: Setup downloads a model and collections in the app from pinned Hugging Face revisions; the 1.4.1 public APK did this on a Redmi 13C. Not yet run from the 1.4.2 public APK on a clean phone.

requirements.obligation: Include assets or provide clear download and installation instructions
requirements.note: Models and collections download in the app from pinned Hugging Face revisions, each checked against its size and SHA-256; a .fapack can be imported instead.

requirements.obligation: Publish a public demo on X or Farcaster
requirements.note: Earlier demos show older builds; a 1.4.2 demo is still to be posted.

requirements.obligation: Demo offline use, hard queries, repository link, and approach
requirements.note: A 1.4.2 demo of offline use, hard questions and the repository link is still to be recorded.

requirements.obligation: Submit a relevant POIDH screenshot with demo and repository links
requirements.note: The existing claim describes an older build; it is to be updated after the 1.4.2 release.

requirements.obligation: Keep the functional reviewed version in GitHub at claim time
requirements.note: 1.4.2 is committed locally and not yet tagged or released; the claim must point at the released tag.

requirements.obligation: Avoid fraud, malware, plagiarism, material changes, and violations
requirements.note: Fork credited; third-party licences shipped in the app and listed in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.

requirements.obligation: Measure against the greater-than-50-percent quality bar transparently
requirements.note: Measured transparently on sealed sets graded blind in two rounds against web-researched answers (docs/testing-1.4.2.md, every grade published). Gemma 4 26B on 12 GB phones is above the bar on that measure (27 of 40 good answers, 68%; 82-84% of the reference's score on set 33); the 4B and the 2B are below it.
